elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The clause warrants only that services will conform to the requirements of the Agreement. It does not independently require professional and workmanlike performance, and no such Agreement requirement is demonstrated.

elements.element: All deliverables, including software, conform to applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause covers the Site and software only and requires conformity only “in all material respects,” rather than unqualified conformity of all deliverables to documentation.

elements.element: The software documentation-conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The operative warranty lasts only 90 days following the Company's acceptance.

elements.element: The services performance warranty lasts 90 days.
elements.evidence: The operative services warranty lasts only 30 days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: For breach, HDI must, at the Company's election, repair the non-conforming Site, software, or services.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: For breach, HDI must, at the Company's election, replace the non-conforming Site, software, or services.

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: For breach, HDI must, at the Company's election, refund the amounts paid for the non-conforming Site, software, or services.

elements.element: HDI warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in the operative language.

elements.element: HDI warrants that deliverables and software contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The operative language contains no malicious-code warranty.

elements.element: Software, including the Site, conforms to applicable documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause warrants conformity only “in all material respects,” which permits nonmaterial deviations and therefore does not provide the unqualified documentation-conformance warranty.

elements.element: The software documentation-conformance warranty lasts 90 days.
elements.evidence: The warranty applies for 90 days following the Company's acceptance to the Site and software HDI delivers or makes available.

elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The clause requires services to conform to the Agreement but does not impose a professional-and-workmanlike standard.

elements.element: The services performance warranty lasts 30 days.
elements.evidence: The services warranty applies for 30 days following performance.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the fallback warranties.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's election, repair the non-conforming Site, software, or services.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the fallback warranties.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's election, replace the non-conforming Site, software, or services.

elements.element: Refund is available as a remedy for breach of the fallback warranties.
elements.evidence: HDI must, at the Company's election, refund the amounts paid for the non-conforming Site, software, or services.

result.reason: The amendment is targeted and leaves the existing warranties and Globix provision intact, but it does not complete either level. It supplies the fallback durations and all three remedies, yet omits a professional-and-workmanlike services standard and qualifies software conformity by materiality. It also omits the preferred 12/90-day durations, compliance-with-laws warranty, and malicious-code warranty. Drafting quality is reduced by the lack of punctuation separating subsection (b) from the new warranty paragraph.
